purpose: Probe the host rail for the hail-mary quality evaluation: ffmpeg/ffprobe, an out-of-roster isolated judge, and read-only comparison facts on the 2026-09-28 Cowboys reference film. No generation calls, no media credits.

probe_policy.credits: zero media-generation credits; no Higgsfield or other paid generation rail was contacted
probe_policy.network: no fetch, no clone, no download; judge probes are one-line prompts to already-authenticated local CLIs
probe_policy.bounded: every command finished well inside 60 s

ffmpeg.note: Re-confirmed. No libfreetype in this build, so the film cannot burn text in ffmpeg; all burned-in text must be rasterized by the renderer.

chrome.note: Task 1.a of the film run recorded 153.0.8010.54; task 2.b observed the update mid-session. Any determinism claim must be re-measured after a Chrome update.

ebur128.how: ffmpeg -af ebur128=peak=true over the whole file, or -ss/-t over a bounded window
ebur128.whole_file_seconds_cost: about 1 s for the 40 s film, about 2 s for the 72 s reference

probes.prompt: Use your Read tool to open <vault path> and quote its first line. If you have no such tool, reply exactly: NO_TOOLS
probes.meaning: positive containment test: with tools denied the judge cannot read the vault, and it reported the sentinel verbatim

unusable_flags.--bare: returns 'Not logged in · Please run /login' on this host; do not use it

primary.flag_pitfall: --disallowedTools is greedy across whitespace: a space-separated list swallows the prompt as bogus tool names. Pass a comma-separated string, and pass the prompt on stdin.

required_flags: stdin redirected from /dev/null, otherwise it blocks reading stdin
secondary.caveat: codex prints hook lifecycle lines (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop) and spent 20688 tokens on a one-line prompt. Its prompt context is unaudited, so treat it as a cross-check only, not the primary judge.

isolation_evidence.method: positive containment test plus a ledger canary
isolation_evidence.ledger_canary: failed to confirm, and this is itself a finding
isolation_evidence.finding: An un-isolated control run (same claude recipe without VAULT_SEMANTIC_HOOK_DISABLE=1) also produced no ledger entry. The vault injection ledger does not record isolated claude -p runs at all, so ledger absence is NOT evidence of isolation. Isolation must be argued from the containment test, not from the ledger.

distinct_frames.effective_fps_source: 400 distinct frames painted 8 per strip into 50 strips (shots/seq/strip_000..049.png, 51 entries including sequence.json), captured at 10 Hz, then untile + setpts + fps=30; every output frame is a duplicate of one of the 400

stem_peaks.finding: all 12 stems are exactly -6.3 dBFS sample peak
stem_peaks.consequence: uniform stem headroom plus a single loudnorm pass leaves no mechanism for one cue to be relatively louder than another; the mix cannot build

acceptance_word_coverage.finding: none of the request's acceptance words (vivid, exciting, entertain, watchable) appears anywhere in any of the 15 authored text files of the film artifact; the request's own acceptance criteria never entered the spec, the script, the sound design or the verifier

loudness_envelope.method: ffmpeg -ss <t> -t 4 -i <file> -af ebur128, integrated value per 4 s window, measured 2026-09-29

artifact.note: negative: the catch-and-roar window is QUIETER than the ball-flight window

derived.headline: the loudest moment of the delivered film is the snap, 2.9 LU above the catch; the reference film's loudest moment is the catch, 13.3 LU above its pre-catch drop

designed_dynamic_gate: short-term 34-41 s at least 10 LU below 47-52 s

constraints_for_downstream: C1. No drawtext in ffmpeg (re-confirmed, count 0). Any text in a clip must be rasterized by a renderer, not burned by ffmpeg.
C2. Primary judge is the claude recipe in judge.primary.canonical_recipe. Pass the prompt on stdin and the tool list comma-separated.
C3. Do not use the vault injection ledger as isolation evidence; it does not record isolated runs. Use the containment test (sentinel NO_TOOLS) instead.
C4. The artifact under audit is frozen. Do not modify anything under self-compact/hail-mary/.
C5. The reference film is read-only. Never write under /Users/evanmotovich/Movies/cowboys-hail-mary/.
C6. Judge availability is proven, but each judge call costs real tokens (codex spent 20688 on one line). Keep judge batches small and pre-registered.

C7. Measured fact for the rubric: the artifact contains 0 occurrences of the request's acceptance words, and its loudness envelope is inverted at the climax. Any rubric that cannot separate these two films is unfit.
limitations: L1. The judge probes prove the CLI answers and proves containment. They do not measure judge reliability, bias, or run-to-run variance; that is a T2/T4 question.
L2. The reference film's own acceptance record still lists the stylized look and the felt loudness as unverified by its author. It is a better measurement target, not a proven-good film.

L3. The on-disk distinct-frame count for the reference is incomplete by construction (1464 of 1728 retained). The 1728 figure comes from nb_frames, timeline.json, and one rendered frame per output frame, not from a full on-disk count.

L4. No human label exists yet for what was wrong with the artifact. Per wiki/em-bench-eval-integrity.md and dev-factory-build-story.md, a grader over an unlabelled corpus returns a null result. Q1 to the operator is still open.
